title: Triangulated monoidal categorifications of finite type cluster algebras
summary: We propose a framework of monoidal categorification of finite type cluster algebras involving triangulated monoidal categories. Namely, given a Dynkin quiver $Q$, we consider the bounded homotopy category $\mathcal{K}_Q^{(1)}$ of a symmetric monoidal category $\mathcal{H}_Q^{(1)}$ that we define in terms of the Auslander-Reiten theory of $Q$.
